headline: Labour unrest costs 317 RMG factories Tk8,184cr in lost production, orders: BGMEA
summary: The BGMEA says labour unrest cost 317 RMG factories Tk8,184 crore in lost production and orders. It adds that the actual scale of the damage was far greater than the survey figures show.
why: The Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association represents the country's garment exporters, which are a major source of foreign currency. Production losses and lost orders affect export earnings and buyer relationships.
